_comment: Hand-written expectation for callgraph.S — the analyser is checked
against this, never against its own output. Sizes are instruction
counts x 4 read off the fixture source; addresses are deliberately
absent so a layout change cannot invalidate the oracle.
roots: e_entry (fx_entry), the vector table itself (hardware enters
it), and the branch targets of its slots.
unproven: fx_indirect_target is reached only through an address load
+ blr, and fx_orphan* by nothing at all. Neither is dead code —
unproven means the static rules could not prove reachability.
